ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (35) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Благо» (blago, 'the good') is kept distinct from «добро» throughout, including Tolstoy's «всё благо» (vsyo blago, 'all is good'); «разумением жизни» (razumeniyem zhizni) in Marcus Aurelius is 'by the understanding of life'. Attributions follow the print: «Пифагор Самосский» (Pifagor Samossky, 'Pythagoras of Samos') and «Китайская пословица» (Kitayskaya poslovitsa, 'Chinese proverb').
